name: Documentation Update Reminder
description: Reminds agents to update documentation when code files are modified. Checks if related documentation exists and needs updating.

then.prompt:
A code file was just modified. Please check if related documentation needs updating:

1. Search for documentation files that reference this code (use grep for function names, class names, file paths)
2. If documentation exists and references this code, update it to reflect the changes
3. If no documentation exists but this is a public API or complex logic, consider creating documentation
4. Ensure cross-references are maintained
5. Update 'Last Updated' section in affected docs

Follow the documentation-maintenance skill guidelines. If this is a trivial change (typo, formatting, simple bug fix), you can skip documentation updates.
